content.value: Standard array algorithms accumulate totals, count matches, find extrema, detect duplicates, shift values, and reverse a sequence. State preconditions: finding an extremum requires a nonempty array unless you define an empty-case result. Initialize extrema from the first element, not zero.

The maximum is -2. Initializing max to zero would return a value not in the data. Reversing an array swaps positions i and length - 1 - i until the halfway point; processing every index would undo the swaps.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
